app.name: Rozmarra
app.subtitle: Rozmarra helps doctors plan safer fasts for people with Type 2 Diabetes in India.

planned.body: The team will add this screen on 18 October 2026.
planned.monitor: This screen will replay a recorded fasting day with a time slider. It will show the forecasts and alerts as they would have appeared at each moment.
planned.plan: This screen will produce a printable fasting plan in English and Hindi after the doctor approves a plan.
planned.about: This screen will explain which data Rozmarra uses, how the team tested it, what the results were and what its limits are.

notice.clinical: Rozmarra supports clinical decisions. It does not replace the judgement of a doctor.
notice.prototype: Rozmarra is a research prototype. It is not a certified medical device.
notice.syntheticDetail: All patients in this prototype are synthetic. They do not represent real people.

service.checking: The dashboard is checking the connection to the Rozmarra service.
service.online: The Rozmarra service is running. The service version is {{version}}.
service.offline: The dashboard cannot reach the Rozmarra service. Please start the service with the command "uv run rozmarra serve" in the backend folder.

common.loading: The dashboard is loading the data.
common.errorTitle: The data could not be loaded.
common.errorBody: Something went wrong while the dashboard loaded the data.

idfDar.title: IDF-DAR 2021 risk score
idfDar.description: The International Diabetes Federation and the DAR International Alliance published this score in 2021 to estimate the risk of fasting during Ramadan.
idfDar.bands: A total of 0 to 3 points means low risk, 3.5 to 6 points means moderate risk, and more than 6 points means high risk.
idfDar.missing: Some items are missing, so the total may lie anywhere from {{range}} points.
idfDar.otherFasts: The IDF-DAR score was designed for Ramadan. Rozmarra applies it to other fasts as an approximation.

patients.title: Patients who plan to fast
patients.intro: This list helps you see which patients need attention first. The patients are sorted by the predicted chance of low blood sugar during the fast, from the highest chance to the lowest.
patients.loading: The dashboard is loading the list of patients.
patients.caption: All patients in this list are synthetic.

columns.chance: Predicted chance of low blood sugar during the fast

patients.chanceNote: The predicted chance comes from a simulation of each patient's usual plan (Plan A) on the virtual patient. It is an estimate from a research prototype, not a diagnosis.

patient.backToList: Back to the list of patients
patient.notFound: Rozmarra does not know this patient. Please choose a patient from the list.

virtual.intro: This screen shows what the twin knows about {{name}}, who plans to keep {{fast}} on {{date}}.

record.title: Health record summary
record.description: The synthetic health record is saved in the FHIR R4 format.
record.fastWord: The patient's word for the fast

medicines.title: Usual medicines
medicines.description: The twin uses these doses and times on normal days.

gene.title: Genetic marker CYP2C9
gene.description: The CYP2C9 enzyme clears sulfonylureas, such as glimepiride, from the body.
gene.usual: This patient has the usual CYP2C9 genotype.
gene.reduced: This patient carries a reduced-function CYP2C9 gene variant. Glimepiride may stay in the body longer than usual.
gene.clearance: The twin assumes that this patient clears sulfonylureas at {{percent}}% of the usual speed.

history.title: The last {{days}} days before the fast
history.description: The synthetic glucose and smartwatch data covers {{from}} to {{to}}.
history.loadingSignals: The dashboard is loading the glucose and smartwatch data.
history.glucoseTitle: Glucose from the continuous glucose monitor
history.glucoseSummary: The chart shows the measured glucose from {{from}} to {{to}}. The average glucose was {{mean}} mg/dL. The glucose was from 70 to 180 mg/dL for {{inRange}}% of the time and below 70 mg/dL for {{below}}% of the time.
history.heartSummary: The chart shows the heart rate from {{from}} to {{to}}.
history.stepsSummary: The chart shows the steps on each day. The average was {{value}} steps each day.
history.sleepSummary: The chart shows the hours of sleep on each night. The average was {{value}} hours each night.

twin.title: Quality of the twin's fit
twin.description: The twin is a physiology model of glucose, insulin, meals and medicines.
twin.donor: This virtual patient's twin uses the fitted parameters of the real patient {{donor}} from the open {{dataset}} dataset.
twin.fitSentence: On that real patient's held-out days, the twin's 2-hour forecasts differed from the measured glucose by {{value}} mg/dL on average (root mean square error).
twin.heldOutError: Error over 12 hours on held-out days
twin.heldOutMard: Mean relative error on held-out days
twin.reference: These errors come from open data from China and the United States, not from Indian patients.
twin.spreadNote: The spread is the standard deviation of the parameter on the log scale. A larger spread means that the twin is less certain about the value, so the band on the simulation is wider.

parameterNames.beta: Insulin release in response to glucose

sources.title: Data sources
sources.record: The health record is synthetic and saved as a FHIR R4 Bundle.
sources.twin: The twin uses the fitted parameters of the real patient {{donor}} from open anonymised data.
sources.history: The glucose and smartwatch history is synthetic.

simulator.formIntro: Change the times, meals, medicines and activities of Plan A or Plan B. Then test both plans on the virtual patient.
simulator.fixProblems: Please correct the marked fields before you test the plans.
simulator.copyA: Copy Plan A into Plan B
simulator.running: Rozmarra is simulating both plans with 100 versions of the twin. This takes a few seconds.
simulator.stale: The plans have changed since the last test. Please test them again before you approve a plan.
simulator.explainBand: The shaded band shows the range in which 8 of 10 simulated versions of the twin stay, from the 10th to the 90th percentile.
simulator.explainAverage: The grey dotted line shows an average patient with the same plan. It shows how this patient's own twin differs from an average patient.
simulator.explainChance: The chances come from a model that combines the twin's simulations with the patient's recent glucose history. They are estimates from a research prototype.

form.templateNote: If you change the type or the date of the fast, Rozmarra rebuilds the plan from the template with the usual medicines.
form.waterAllowed: Water is allowed during the fast
form.dayOffsetOther: {{count}} days from the date of the fast

food.fast_absorbing: Fast-absorbing food, such as sweets, sabudana or dates
food.slow_absorbing: A meal that is high in fibre, fat or protein

form.addedMedicine: The doctor added this medicine to the plan.
form.noActivities: This plan has no planned activity.

problems.dose: This dose is above the largest single dose that Rozmarra accepts ({{max}} {{unit}}).
problems.fastEnd: The end of the fast must be later than the start of the fast.
problems.activityEnd: The activity must end after it starts.

results.tableCaption: The table compares the two plans. The values come from simulations on the virtual patient.
results.chanceOfLow: Chance of low blood sugar during the fast
results.chanceOfHigh: Chance of high blood sugar after the fast is broken
results.noBreakingMeal: No meal breaks the fast in this plan.
results.sentenceA: With Plan A, the predicted lowest glucose is {{value}} mg/dL at about {{time}}.
results.sentenceB: With Plan B, the predicted lowest glucose is {{value}} mg/dL at about {{time}}.
results.cautionBoth: This caution applies to both plans.
results.chartSummary: The chart shows the simulated glucose for {{plan}}. The predicted lowest glucose is {{value}} mg/dL at about {{time}}. The chance of low blood sugar during the fast is {{percent}}%.

approve.title: Approve {{plan}}
approve.description: After you approve this plan, Rozmarra can print it for the patient. The plan will show your name and today's date.
approve.nameHelp: Rozmarra adds the title "Dr" before the name.

chart.averagePatient: Average patient with the same plan
chart.fastWithoutWater: Fasting window, no food or water
